Both readings fit the text, and M1/M2 must reproduce these bytes exactly, so the chosen reading should be recorded (errata or M0 notes) before sign-off. The rest checks out: tighter order, no coverage obligation (no call channel), no L1 authority+ part (the final Update forbid still excludes HardDelete and Update), coverage 2/2, blocked by rule 1.

The E-conduct causes are [declared fact d09a9720…, code purgeOldEvents] and do not include the forbid claim. Every v7 contradiction in the set gains its own claim as root cause, so the two patterns are inconsistent. The text does not fix the causes for errors.

The deltas justify this as 'no identity … resolves a free name to another', but the proof record lists verus:…#StrictlyOrderedVec::insert at contract as a callee contract dep (A.14.2.2).
